qrender-edit: Label of the action that opens a statement on Wikidata to edit it.
qrender-add-label: Label of the action that opens Wikidata to add a label in the reader's language, on a label that is shown in another language.
qrender-credit: Label of the button that shows the author and the licence of a picture.
qrender-close: Label of the button that closes a dialog.
qrender-bce:
A year before the common era. Parameters:
* $1 - the year, without a sign (300 for 300 BCE).
qrender-some-value: Shown for a statement whose value is "unknown value" on Wikidata.
qrender-age:
The age of a person at death, after the date of death. Parameters:
* $1 - the number of years.
qrender-language: The label of the choice of language in the names of an item.
qrender-add-value: The label of the action to add a name in the chosen language, on a name that is shown in another language (a fallback).
qrender-show-map: The label of the pin button before a coordinate: it opens a dialog with a map of the point.
qrender-view-larger: The label of the button on a picture of the item: it opens a dialog with the picture, large, and its author, licence and file on Commons. Screen readers read it.
qrender-play: The label of the play button on the poster of a video of the item: it opens a dialog where the video plays, large, with its controls. Screen readers read it.
qrender-view-model: The label of the button on the picture of a 3D model of the item: it opens a dialog where the reader can turn the model. Screen readers read it.
qrender-model-loading:
The status over the picture of a 3D model while the model file loads (it can be tens of MB). Parameters:
* $1 - the share loaded, as a percentage ("45%"); empty when the size of the file is not known.
qrender-model-unsupported: The status over the picture of a 3D model when the file is in a format that the page cannot draw (an ASCII STL file). The picture stays.
qrender-explore-map: The label of the button on the map of the item: it opens a dialog with the map, large, which the reader can move and zoom. Screen readers read it.
qrender-map-attribution: The credit of the map data, in the corner of a map that the reader moves and zooms. It links to the copyright page of OpenStreetMap.
qrender-article-more: The title of the part at the end of a page with the sections of the article (in another language, when the page language has no article) that no other part of the page shows. Each section is collapsed to its title.
qrender-translate:
The label of the button on a section of the article in another language (the page language has no article): it opens an editor with the machine translation of the section. Parameters:
* $1 - the name of the page language.
qrender-translation-note: After the name of the page language, above the machine translation in the editor of a section: the text is a machine translation, and the reader corrects it.
qrender-translating: In place of a paragraph of the machine translation, while it is not there yet.
qrender-translate-failed: Under a paragraph that the machine translation service did not translate: the paragraph shows the source text.
qrender-discard: The button that closes the editor of a translation and drops the translation.
qrender-save: The button that saves the translation of a section. In this prototype the translation is not published.
qrender-saved: The note after a reader saves a translation: in this prototype, the translation stays on the page and is not published.
qrender-view-all: The label of the last card of a strip of pictures (the values of one property): it opens a dialog with all the values, with their pictures and qualifiers. The count is in the heading of the strip.
qrender-former: A mark after the label of a row of the fact sheet: its values ended (the former capitals of a country). The current values of the property are in another row or block.
qrender-description: The name of the (i) button after the label of a property: it shows the description of the property. Screen readers read it.
qrender-contents: The name of the list of links to the sections of the page, under the banner. Screen readers read it; it is not shown.
qrender-earlier: A mark after the label of a media property: its files that ended, before the current one (the earlier flags of a country). It is followed by the years they cover.
qrender-other-value: A mark on a measurement of a year that has another value, the preferred one (from another source). It is in the table and the tooltip of a chart.
qrender-footer:
The note at the end of a page. Parameters:
* $1 - a link to the item on Wikidata, with its id as text.
* $2 - the versions of the composition, the view and the design system.
